items.title: Trump says he’s making America’s economy great again. He’s addressing the wrong problem
items.summary: For many people, the economy is a simple equation: paychecks minus expenses. When it feels like our incomes are growing faster than prices, the economy is in good shape. When they’re not, it’s lousy.
